label: NOTE: what this set reaches, what it cannot, and the one mutation that is EQUIVALENT rather than uncaught
why: V90TRN2Designer's four working members and t_v90trn2design.cpp were written from one reading of .text+0x3ca10-0x3da17. Every entry below is a claim the disassembly makes. THREE OF THEM NEEDED A BUILT INPUT RATHER THAN A SAMPLED ONE, and each is recorded in the test beside the case that reaches it: the 1e-6 guard in maxK only bites on an EXACT POWER OF TWO, so 2^21 and 2^22 are driven because they bracket the point where the guard runs out (finding F4400); `slot >= 0` differs from `slot > 0` only at zero, which only the descending arm can produce and only by breaking on its last placement, so that table is a step and not a ramp (finding F4404); and the 199-round cap only shows where a design succeeds later than a mutated cap and no later than the real one, which needed a sweep of the step height so the round count crosses the window -- it now catches 199 -> 198. WHAT NO ENTRY HERE CAN REACH: `V90TRN2Design`'s phase-K divide. Spelling it `x * (1.0f / y)` instead of `x / y` is a genuinely EQUIVALENT MUTANT, searched rather than assumed -- in 80-bit arithmetic there is no (N, level) with N <= 64 and level <= 32767, which is the whole of what a `short` table and this parameter can supply, where the two disagree after the `(short)` truncation. The codegen tier is what settles that site: `fdivp` against `fdivr`+`fmulp`, finding F4403. The SEED divide in the other arm is not equivalent and is caught.
